name: @agentry/workbench
description: The Agentry Workbench — the local Agent Center: a React + Vite + Tiptap app over a file-watching local service. This package is the ANCHOR whose @agentry/* workspace deps the server bundle's dist-lockstep hash walks (so a change to @agentry/flow/src marks plugin/workbench/server stale) — that is what its `dependencies` are for, and why it exists as a package at all. It deliberately has NO build/typecheck script: @agentry/workbench-web and @agentry/workbench-server are workspace packages in their own right, so `pnpm -r` already reaches them. A script here that re-invoked them made `pnpm -r build` run each TWICE, concurrently, into the same output directory. See VISION.md.
